rows.quote: METHODS: We examined associations between 2922 plasma proteins and blood pressure (BP) traits (systolic BP [SBP] and diastolic BP [DBP], and prevalent hypertension) in 45 991 UK Biobank participants with validation in 5759 FHS (Framingham Heart Study) participants.
rows.coder_note: The authors' own analysis of FHS individual-level data, defined by phenotype (SBP, DBP, prevalent hypertension) and analytic sample (5759 participants); the dictionary has no outcome row for it (rule C applied to the authors' own analysis; the abstract names no other source for the blood pressure outcomes).
